clean_source_blocks.text: US President Donald Trump has said the month-long ceasefire between the US and Iran is on "massive life support". He told reporters in the Oval Office on Monday that while the ceasefire remains in place, it is "unbelievably weak". Iran laid out its demands to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz in a counteroffer sent to the US over the weekend. Trump rejected the proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable" and a "piece of garbage". Esmail Baghaei, a foreign ministry spokesperson for Iran, responded by saying Tehran's proposals were "responsible" and "generous". Tehran's offer includes an immediate end to the war on all fronts, a halt to the US naval blockade of Iranian ports and guarantees of no further attacks on Iran, according to Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency.
The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

WASHINGTON, DC - MAY 11: U.S. President Donald Trump speaks at an event on maternal healthcare in the Oval Office of the White House on May 11, 2026 in Washington, DC. The Trump administration recently launched Moms.gov, a website to help provide resources to expecting women and their families. (Photo by Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images) President Donald Trump believes the ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is on “life support.” Trump spoke on the subject Monday in the Oval Office. “It’s unbelievably weak,” Trump told reporters who asked if the ceasefire with Iran remains in place. “I would say the ceasefire is on massive life support [and] when the doctor walks in and says, ‘Sir, your loved one has approximately a one percent chance of living,’” he said.

.@POTUS on the ceasefire in Iran: "After reading that piece of garbage they sent us… It's on life support." pic.twitter.com/MyfmPZeOmB Iran laid out its demands in a counteroffer sent to the U.S. over the weekend. The New York Times reported the demands included war reparations, Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and an end to U.S. sanctions. The president the counteroffer “totally unacceptable.” On Monday, Trump referred to the counteroffer as a “piece of garbage,” adding he did not finish reading it. Iran is also looking to separate nuclear talks from the negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration wants nuclear commitments up front. The U.S. is also pressuring Iran to drop its claim on the Strait of Hormuz, for which Iran has thought about a long-term tolling system.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
US President Donald Trump has said the month-long ceasefire between the US and Iran is on "massive life support".

He told reporters in the Oval Office on Monday that while the ceasefire remains in place, it is "unbelievably weak".

Iran laid out its demands to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz in a counteroffer sent to the US over the weekend. Trump rejected the proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable" and a "piece of garbage".

Esmail Baghaei, a foreign ministry spokesperson for Iran, responded by saying Tehran's proposals were "responsible" and "generous".

Tehran's offer includes an immediate end to the war on all fronts, a halt to the US naval blockade of Iranian ports and guarantees of no further attacks on Iran, according to Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency.

It also reportedly includes a demand for compensation for war damage and an emphasis on Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz.

Trump criticised the proposal, writing on Truth Social on Sunday: "I have just read the response from Iran's so-called 'Representatives.' I don't like it - TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE."

In response to Trump's comments, Baghaei said Iran would act "in any way necessary to secure our interests".

Speaking in the Oval Office later on Monday, Trump addressed the ceasefire between the two countries which has largely been observed since April despite occasional exchanges of fire.

He told reporters: "I would say the ceasefire is on massive life support … when the doctor walks in and says, 'Sir, your loved one has approximately a 1 percent chance of living.'"

The US president said Iran's leaders were "very dishonourable people", adding: "Look, I've had to deal with them four or five times – they change their mind."

"That piece of garbage they sent us - I didn't even finish reading it," he said.

Trump also accused Iran of going back on an agreement to allow the US to remove its supply of enriched uranium. He insisted that Iran would "never have a nuclear weapon".

Iran's Tasnim news agency quoted a source close to the negotiating team as saying: "There is no such thing in Iran's proposal as accepting taking out enriched nuclear material."

Earlier this week, Trump repeated that the war in Iran will be "over quickly".

But Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that Iran's stockpile of enriched uranium must be "taken out" before the war can be considered over.

The Trump administration recently launched Moms.gov, a website to help provide resources to expecting women and their families. (Photo by Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images)

President Donald Trump believes the ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is on “life support.”

Trump spoke on the subject Monday in the Oval Office.

“It’s unbelievably weak,” Trump told reporters who asked if the ceasefire with Iran remains in place.

“I would say the ceasefire is on massive life support [and] when the doctor walks in and says, ‘Sir, your loved one has approximately a one percent chance of living,’” he said.

.@POTUS on the ceasefire in Iran: "After reading that piece of garbage they sent us… It's on life support." pic.twitter.com/MyfmPZeOmB

Iran laid out its demands in a counteroffer sent to the U.S. over the weekend.

Iran is also looking to separate nuclear talks from the negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration wants nuclear commitments up front.

payload.title: Trump tyrmäsi Iranin vastaehdotuksen ja kuvasi tulitaukoa hyvin heikoksi
payload.summary: Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump sanoo, että Yhdysvaltain ja Iranin välinen kuukauden mittainen tulitauko on yhä voimassa, mutta erittäin heikolla pohjalla. Iran pitää omaa ehdotustaan vastuullisena ja anteliaana.
payload.content:
Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump on arvostellut jyrkästi Iranin viikonloppuna lähettämää vastaehdotusta, jonka tarkoituksena on päättää sota ja avata Hormuzinsalmi. Trump sanoi maanantaina Valkoisen talon Oval Officessa, että Yhdysvaltain ja Iranin kuukauden mittainen tulitauko on edelleen voimassa, mutta hänen mukaansa se on äärimmäisen heikko ja vakavasti uhatulla pohjalla.

## Trump hylkäsi Iranin esityksen

Trumpilta kysyttiin maanantaina toimittajien edessä, onko tulitauko Iranin kanssa yhä voimassa. Hän vastasi, että se on, mutta kuvasi järjestelyä hyvin heikoksi. Hän vertasi tilannetta siihen, että lääkäri kertoisi läheisellä olevan vain noin prosentin mahdollisuus selvitä.

Presidentti sanoi lukeneensa Iranin lähettämää esitystä ja piti sitä Yhdysvalloille kelpaamattomana. Hän kuvasi vastaehdotusta täysin hyväksymättömäksi ja käytti siitä poikkeuksellisen kovaa kieltä. Trumpin mukaan hän ei edes lukenut ehdotusta loppuun.

## Teheran puolustaa ehdotustaan

Iranin ulkoministeriön tiedottaja Esmail Baghaei puolusti Teheranin linjaa ja sanoi Iranin ehdotusten olevan vastuullisia ja anteliaita. Iranin puolivirallisen Tasnim-uutistoimiston mukaan Teheranin tarjous sisältää sodan välittömän lopettamisen kaikilla rintamilla, Yhdysvaltain Iranin satamiin kohdistaman merisaarron päättämisen sekä takeet siitä, ettei Iraniin kohdisteta uusia hyökkäyksiä.

Lähdetietojen mukaan Iranin vastaehdotuksessa on ollut esillä myös sotakorvauksia, Iranin suvereniteettia Hormuzinsalmessa sekä Yhdysvaltain pakotteiden lopettamista. Ehdotus liittyy samalla pyrkimykseen avata Hormuzinsalmi uudelleen.

## Ydinkysymykset mutkistavat neuvotteluja

Neuvotteluja vaikeuttaa myös se, että Iranin kerrotaan haluavan erottaa ydinkeskustelut Hormuzinsalmen avaamista koskevista neuvotteluista. Trumpin hallinto taas haluaa ydinsitoumuksia etupainotteisesti ennen etenemistä muissa kysymyksissä.

Yhdysvallat painostaa Irania luopumaan Hormuzinsalmeen liittyvästä vaatimuksestaan. Lähdetietojen mukaan Iran on pohtinut salmeen myös pidemmän aikavälin maksujärjestelmää. Trumpin maanantaiset kommentit osoittavat, ettei tulitauko ole virallisesti romahtanut, mutta Washingtonin ja Teheranin näkemykset Iranin ehdotuksen sisällöstä ja merkityksestä ovat kaukana toisistaan.
summary_bullets: Trump sanoo Yhdysvaltain ja Iranin tulitauon olevan edelleen voimassa mutta hyvin heikko.
Iranin vastaehdotus sisältää sodan lopettamisen, merisaarron päättämisen ja takeet uusien hyökkäysten estämisestä.
Neuvotteluissa kiistellään myös Hormuzinsalmesta ja ydinsitoumusten käsittelystä.
